user.description: Adds voice commands to Assist that run before any conversation agent, including LLM agents. You can change the sentences afterwards in the integration options.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

init.title: Voice commands
init.description: Reset conversation: one sentence per line, no punctuation. Use [word] for optional words and (a|b) for alternatives. Matching ignores case but not accents, so list both spellings when your speech-to-text is inconsistent.

data_description.reset_sentences: Saying one of these clears the current conversation's history.
data_description.reset_response: What the assistant says after resetting. Leave empty to stay silent.

reset_conversation.name: Reset conversation
reset_conversation.description: Clears Assist conversation history so the next request starts a new conversation. Without a conversation ID, all conversations are reset.

conversation_id.name: Conversation ID
conversation_id.description: Only reset this conversation. Leave empty to reset all conversations.
